newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, HIT 261-7 VS TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, HIT 261-7 VS TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Australia scored 261 for seven in 45 overs against a Transvaal Invitation XI at the Elkah Stadium.

Mark Taylor won the toss and after the early loss of Greg Blewett for six runs flowed freely for the tourists. Matthew Elliott's 69 from 91 balls with five fours and two sixes was the highest score of the innings.

Elliott put on 117 for the second wicket with Justin Langer who made 63 from 82 balls with four fours and a six. Michael Bevan (49) and Matthew Hayden (47) kept the impetus going with a 98 run partnership in just 11 overs before medium pacer Andrew Hal initiated a late collapse.

Hall picked up the wickets of Bevan, Hayden and Mark Waugh for a first ball duck in his last over, the 44th of the innings and with Taylor going for two in the final over four wickets fell for four runs in nine balls.
